intro.text: A flower from before the Lord Ruler's Ascension, after which the world had no flowers. Kelsier's wife, Mare, who collected pictures of the old era, kept a picture of one that puzzled Kelsier and Vin.

A flower of Scadrial, once known only from a picture Kelsier's wife Mare kept, that now grows on the Field of Rebirth, on the hill that leads up to the tombs of the Ascendant Warrior and the Last Emperor.

description.text: The Ghostbloods' insignia of three overlapping diamonds is based on the marewill flower.

items.text: Mare held on to a scrap of paper showing a flower, a plant neither Kelsier nor Vin had ever seen.
OreSeur gave Vin a bag holding atium beads, a note, the Eleventh Metal and the flower picture Mare had treasured.
Vin left the picture with Sazed. Mare had been a follower of the Larsta religion.
Sazed found Mare's drawing tucked inside the journal of prophecy notes he had put together with Tindwyl.
Sazed drew on the picture, along with other Larsta descriptions of plants, to help restore the world, and left the original in one of his books for Spook.
Marewill flowers bloom across the Field of Rebirth, on the slope climbing toward the tombs and statues of the Ascendant Warrior and the Last Emperor.
